what_to_detect: A resolution that instructs a player to suspect a permanent already suspected in the snapshot before it, and gives it no suspected designation change (no state_flag_change, no menace gained).
near_miss: A resolution that suspects a permanent that was not suspected, which gains the designation.
record_fields: snapshot card designations (gen-3), before the resolution

what_to_detect: A continuous record in which the suspected static applies to a permanent that is no longer suspected (its designation was ended by an ability): the designation is absent from the entity the suspected static's menace would go to.
near_miss: A continuous record in which the suspected static contributes menace to a permanent still holding the suspected designation.

what_to_detect: A continuous record in which a permanent that left the battlefield and returned as a new object lacks the suspected designation the earlier object held.
near_miss: A continuous record in which a permanent that stayed on the battlefield (control change included) still holds the designation and gets menace.

what_to_detect: A continuous record in which a permanent that is a copy of a suspected permanent lacks the suspected designation: the designation is not a copiable value.
near_miss: A continuous record in which a permanent that is a copy holds the designation because its own ability suspected it.

what_to_detect: A blockers record whose anchor attacker holds the suspected designation writes min_blockers of 2 or more (menace); a suspected creature is also outside the legal blockers (it can't block).
near_miss: The same kind of creature without the suspected designation (and no menace of its own): one blocker suffices.
record_fields: the judged or anchor entity's gen-3 designations (suspected)
